exposure: gestational age of 8 weeks or more
finding: Uterine evacuation after medical abortion with mifepristone and vaginal misoprostol was uncommon (3.5%) and significantly associated with five or more prior deliveries and gestational age of 8 weeks or more.
mod_finding: Having five or more prior deliveries was significantly associated with the need for uterine evacuation after medical abortion, while younger age (20 years or younger) was inversely associated.
